comment: Mohammed was absolutely outstanding. He brought Nizwa Fort to life with stories I would never have found in a guidebook. The local market was the highlight — he knew every stall and introduced us to people who have been trading there for generations. Highly recommended.

Fatima knows the Dhofar landscape like nowhere else. The wadi walk she arranged was breathtaking and she had interesting facts at every stop. Her French was perfect too which made the whole experience very comfortable for us. A wonderful guide.

Khalid organised the most magical evening — we watched loggerhead turtles nesting at Ras Al Hadd and then had a dhow breakfast on the lagoon the next morning. He clearly loves what he does and it shows. Worth every rial.
